content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Spokane

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Spokane professionals entering the field or transitioning into project management roles across healthcare, aerospace, construction, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format fits working schedules, covering PMI's CAPM framework across project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing. Flexible scheduling accommodates Spokane's diverse industries and shift patterns.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete the CAPM application, documenting your secondary degree and education completion. Pay the required exam fee through PMI's portal. Our team provides guidance on application accuracy to ensure smooth processing.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and study guides aligned to PMI's CAPM content outline. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE and sit for the 150-question, multiple-choice assessment at a testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Renew your credential every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through PMI-approved activities, training, and project management experience. Spokane's active project management community offers abundant networking and learning opportunities to support ongoing development.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

Spokane's healthcare expansion creates steady demand for credentialed professionals.
